export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for slug 'k2-cranes-components-private-limited' (entity 'K2 CRANES & COMPONENTS PRIVATE LIMITED', Survey No 352/1 Authiramerur Road, Pukkathurai) states 'Total Shipments 218 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2025-11-29', and shows dated export rows, e.g. '2025-11-29 | K2 CRANES & COMPONENTS PRIVATE LIMITED | M/S.ROPA ENGINEERING COMPANY LIMITE | RAIL ( 55 METERS BAY LENGTH (40MM X 40MM | CHENNAI SEA, India | Mombasa, Kenya | 84314920 | 6667744' and '2025-11-17 | ... | TECHNOMAC CRANE SERVICES LLC | INDUSTRIAL CRANE ACCESSORIES HOIST BRAKE | CHENNAI AIR, India | DUBAI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 84314920 | 3820704'. Second slug 'k2-cranes-and-components-private-limited' (14-A Telugu Brahmin Street, Velacherry) shows 'Total Shipments 8 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2025-09-30', with export rows e.g. '2025-09-06 | ... | JEBEL ALI | INDUSTRIAL CRANE ACCESSORIES-DESING MANUFACTURE AND SUPPLY OF 3 TON SINGLE GIRDER EOTCRANES 20 METERS SPAN | CHENNAI SEA, India | UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 84261100 | 9392506'. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 218 shipments for the Pukkathurai entity but only 5 rows rendered in free view; second entity claims 8 shipments, 5 rows rendered. Ports listed: CHENNAI AIR 14, DUBAI 14, CHENNAI SEA 2, Mombasa 2.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split was retrieved. ImportKey free view shows only customs (cross-border) rows; no domestic supply record was visible in the sources read. Domestic turnover and domestic contract data are not public in the pages accessed — recorded as null, not estimated.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with HS codes and B/L numbers exist for outbound shipments from Chennai Sea and Chennai Air to Kenya (Mombasa), UAE (Dubai/Jebel Ali) and Norway (Fornebu/Oslo, HS 84853000). Declared HS 843149 matches the dominant observed export code 84314920 (crane parts) — no HS correction needed; note that some rows carry 84261100 (overhead travelling cranes) and 84853000 (winches), so the company ships across several crane-related codes. Two distinct addresses appear under near-identical names (Pukkathurai factory address vs Velacherry registered address), which likely reflects the same company at different points in time or two group entities — this should be reconciled against MCA before final onboarding, but it is not a shipment-evidence issue. The company also appears as an importer (suppliers Shanghai Maxload Cranes & Hoists, Zhejiang Sapelem, Newcomen SRL, INI Hydraulic), i.e. it is a manufacturer_trader profile: it both imports components and re-exports/supplies crane accessories. Domestic supply status is genuinely unknown rather than negative — absence of GST/GeM data in the sources read is a data gap, not proof of no domestic sales, and per project rules this is not a rejection ground. No sanctions, litigation or ownership issues were examined in this pass (out of scope for this role).
